name: A v2 document that mounts a Team
_comment: The fixture the schema policy requires: a document at the OLD version,
loaded and compiled by the suite so the v2 -> v3 migration is exercised
Deliberately carries the three things a Team could hold and a Workflow
mount must not lose: the slug it mounts, its per-mount overrides, and the
authored `outcome` prose. Do not 'fix' the team.workflow type below — it
being stale is the entire point of the file.
